name: Kenneth Oaur
text: Kenneth Oaur is one of the names of the Brahan Seer. His Gaelic name is Coinneach Odhar. He was a prophet of the seventeenth century. His full title, Coinneach Odhar Fiosaiche, means Sombre Kenneth of the Prophecies.

attributes.attribute: another name of the Brahan Seer
